groups.id: Gallery indexing and deterministic fixture authority
groups.trace: The four explicit match arms precede puzzle indexes4..8, so subtraction of BASE4 and indexing five puzzle kinds is bounded. Road index subtraction is guarded by index>=9; catalogue get returns false before character/subject construction for an absent ordinal. Fixed character IDs are deliberate development fixtures. Road character ID saturating subtraction and ordinal+1 are only fed the actual compiled bounded catalogue, previously read in166; no huge ordinal accepted in ordinary generation is established. The synchronous gallery loop increments once per successful item and terminates at the first absent catalogue definition; its actual catalogue is finite, but the per-reducer work budget requires the real bootstrap caller and cannot be inferred solely from the one-item helper comment. Primary-character existence postcondition does not prove all subordinate fixture state. All fallible child operations propagate here; outer catches/transaction semantics remain separate. Autopsy/outbreak/threat fixtures use fixed subjects and ordinary discovery/materialization paths. Do not revive withdrawn ROOT-INITIAL04-F086 from obsolete threat context.

Represented retained rows [u32MAX,1] can overflow aggregate, same unchecked aggregate family as audit/continuation/native/initial05-aggregate-states/findings.jsonl#49 NATIVE-INITIAL05-F047, already connected in202; actual fresh fixed fixture holdings are small, no ordinary dev fixture overflow claimed. Awareness max6000 cannot itself increase an admitted <=10000 value beyond10000; an already malformed higher raw value is admission, not a mutation-produced violation. Scenario view collects all rows then truncates256, so output cap alone is not input work bound. Quest view bounds subject input512 and each problem/contract input256 before sorting; road subjects<=512, total pre-output rows<=1024 and output<=256. Taking before sorting is a selection policy, not integer overflow. Projection gateways and capability checks precede all collection.
